title: Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale Situational Awareness, the AI fund run by Leopold Aschenbrenner, cut IREN about 94% and exited Core Scientific, Riot and Hive in the third quarter, leaving $80.8 million in three miner stocks after a July sale to Citadel. This post Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
